comment: high-energy professor who clearly knows her stuff, more than willing to help those who put in effort, constant in-class participation is a must, meets 5 times a week (+ 2 Drill sessions), entirely-reliant on textbook/VHL, she makes an effort to show videos/do fun activities, rewarding to do well but requires a sizable amount of work outside class

She is a passionate professor who is almost always accessible. She did a great job at managing the skill differences present in our class. She is knowledgeable about the Spanish speaking world and often drops anecdotes from her life in Spain.
